Sales Invoice Management
View all invoices with filter tabs — All, Paid, Unpaid, Overdue, Return. Each card shows customer, invoice number, date, amount in SAR, and payment status badge.
End-to-End Invoice Creation
Full invoice creation workflow — customer selection, item line items with qty/rate/amount, accounting dimensions (cost center, project), taxes & charges with shipping rule and incoterm, and Create & Submit.
Tax & Discount Engine
Implemented ERPNext's exact tax and discount algorithm in Dart. Multi-row tax calculation (Actual, On Net Total, On Previous Row Amount), additional discount on Grand Total or Net Total — mobile preview always matches ERPNext submitted values.
OAuth2 Secure Authentication
ERPNext OAuth2 login with Flutter Secure Storage using Android Keystore and iOS Keychain. "Login with ERPNext" button with "Protected by OAuth 2.0" confirmation on the login screen.
Activity Log
Real-time audit trail showing login and logout events with timestamps, action type badges (Success/Login, Success/Logout), and user attribution — live from ERPNext backend.
Roles & Permissions Viewer
View all assigned roles (43 roles) and allowed modules (33 modules) with enabled/disabled status per role. Tabbed interface — Roles tab and Allow Modules tab.
Profile Management
User profile screen showing avatar, name, email, username, language, and timezone. Includes Change Password dialog (new + confirm fields) and Logout button.
Master Data Forms
Dynamic creation forms for New Customer (with contact & address sections), New Cost Center, New Project, New Shipping Rule, New Tax Template, New Tax Category, and New Incoterm — all synced live with ERPNext.

Flutter · Android & iOS
Baguettering Kitchen Orders
Baguettering Catering Services · INCONS Professional Services LLP · Saudi Arabia
In Production

A cross-platform Flutter mobile application that replicates Baguettering Catering Services' Frappe/ERPNext web portal — enabling kitchen staff to browse, create, and manage weekly meal orders entirely from their mobile devices. The app mirrors the website's full workflow: from placing draft orders to tracking status through Pending With Kitchen, Approved, and Preparing stages, with real-time data fetched live from ERPNext with no local database.

Secure Authentication
Session-based login with Flutter Secure Storage (iOS Keychain & Android Keystore). Dynamic CSRF token capture. Passwordless Email Link login via Frappe's send_login_link API.
Order Dashboard
4-status grid (Draft, Pending, Approved, Preparing) with live counts. Month/Year picker with client-side date filtering. Pull-to-refresh and empty state handling.
Change Password
In-app password change using update_password API with current + new + confirm fields. No email required — fully handled within the app.
Security Architecture
No hardcoded API credentials. HTTPS enforcement. Separate read/write headers for CSRF. Sanitized error messages — no raw server tracebacks shown to users.
Navigation Drawer
Side drawer with profile section, My Kitchen Orders, Make an Order, Reset Password, and Logout. ListTile-based for reliable tap detection.
API Integration
8 Frappe REST endpoints integrated. Owner + workflow_state filters. HttpLogger for structured request/response debugging in debug builds.

Native Android · Java
Manappuram Banking & Financial App
Manappuram Comptech and Consultants Limited · India
Production · Nov 2023 – Oct 2025

Enterprise-grade Native Android banking application for Manappuram Finance Ltd — one of India's largest gold loan NBFCs. Built with Kotlin and MVVM architecture, the app serves customers for gold loan management, digital payments, account registration, and financial services. Key contributions include MFA implementation, digital bank account verification via UPI penny drop, biometric login, payment gateway integration, and PAN card verification — all within a security-hardened architecture.

Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
Added OTP verification layer on top of existing credential login. After verifying Customer ID and password, a 6-digit OTP is sent to the registered mobile number with a countdown timer. Login completes only after successful OTP verification — significantly hardening account security.
Biometric / Fingerprint Login
Integrated fingerprint authentication using Android Biometric API. Users can enable fingerprint login from the Services dashboard. Once enabled, subsequent logins use the device fingerprint scanner — eliminating the need to enter credentials every session.
Digital Bank Account Verification
Replaced manual-only bank verification with Setu API reverse penny drop integration. User selects "Digitally" → app detects available UPI apps (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm, etc.) → user pays ₹1 → bank account is automatically verified and name-matched, achieving 75% automation and reducing manual errors by 20%.
Gold Loan Management
Fetches live gold loan data from backend API — inventory ID, gold weight, loan numbers, effective interest rates, interest due, and scheme details. Displays multi-loan details dialog and scheme eligibility alerts with lower interest rate offers (View Schemes → PDF download to device).
Payment Gateway Integration
Full payment integration supporting Pay Partial, Pay Full, and Pay Interest with multiple payment methods — RuPay Card, Other Debit Card, UPI, and Net Banking. Displays bank charges, final payable amount, and Terms & Conditions acceptance before submission.
PAN Card Verification
PAN number entry triggers live API validation. On success, the form expands to allow PAN card image upload — enabling full KYC update flow within the app. Invalid PAN numbers are rejected in real time.
Feedback Module
Dynamic customer feedback form with radio button and text field questions — customer type, discovery channel, product category, branch visited, staff rating, and overall satisfaction. Submitted live to backend.
App Permissions Management
Custom permissions screen managing Camera (document capture), Location (nearby branches), Contacts (referrals), Media (file storage), Notifications (alerts), and Biometric — each with toggle controls and clear user-facing explanations of usage.
Security Engineering
Fortified app by 90%+ through MFA, SSL Pinning, Root/Tamper Detection, and Code Obfuscation. Mitigated VAPT vulnerabilities. Improved processing efficiency by 15% through optimised Retrofit2 integrations and Kotlin Coroutines/Flow reactive patterns.
MVVM Architecture
Designed with MVVM and Modular App Architecture using Jetpack (ViewModel, LiveData, Navigation with SafeArgs), Dagger Hilt for DI, and Kotlin Coroutines. Unit and functional testing maintained 100% reliability of delivered features.
Stack: Java MVVM Jetpack Retrofit2 Dagger Hilt Firebase Kotlin Coroutines Setu API Biometric API SSL Pinning OTP / MFA
Native Android · Kotlin
Location-Based Attendance System
Manappuram Comptech and Consultants Limited · India
In Production · Nov 2023 – Oct 2025

A Native Android attendance management feature built in Kotlin, designed to ensure accurate location-based check-ins for field staff. The system validates the user's GPS coordinates in real time — attendance is only recorded if the employee is physically within a 100-metre radius of the designated work location, preventing proxy attendance and ensuring data integrity.

100-Metre Radius Validation
Uses Android Location Services to capture the user's precise GPS coordinates and validates them against the registered work location. Attendance is only accepted when the user is within the 100-metre boundary.
Real-Time Location Tracking
Integrated Android Location Services with live GPS updates. Handles location permission requests, accuracy checks, and graceful fallback when GPS signal is weak or unavailable.
API Integration
Attendance records are submitted live to the backend via REST API using Retrofit2 — storing timestamp, employee ID, GPS coordinates, and validation result for audit purposes.
MVVM Architecture
Built with MVVM architecture using Jetpack ViewModel and LiveData. Clean separation between UI, business logic, and data layer ensures maintainability and testability.
Stack: Kotlin Android Location Services GPS / Geofencing Retrofit2 MVVM Jetpack REST API
